dct_title_s: Reconnaissance geologic map and structure sections of Baja California, Mexico
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by contours and spot heights; depths by isolines.
"Submarine relief by the courtesy of Dr. F. P. Shepard".
Includes cross-sections,"Index map of Baja California, Mexico," and columnar section.
Later published in: Geological Society of America memoir 31. 1946.
Gift of Barry A. Beal, Jr. and the Beal family.
